nodes.title: MD: ACE Sigma Denoise Patcher ✂️

nodes.title: MD: ACE-Step XL Latent Processor 🎛️
nodes.description:
MD: ACE-Step XL Latent Processor  v1.0.0

Post-sampling latent correction. Place between KSampler and VAE Decode.

Operations (in order):
  1. mean_normalize  — subtract per-channel mean (stronger DC correction)
  2. latent_shift    — additive DC offset. Re-centers ACE-Step's
                       non-zero silence_latent distribution.
  3. scale           — multiplicative output level control

Per-variant defaults:
  xl-turbo : -0.12
  xl-sft   : -0.17
  xl-base  : -0.15

nodes.title: MD: ACE-Step XL Loader 🎵
nodes.description:
MD: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Loader  v1.3.0

Loads XL model variants (hidden_size=2560) with tunable AuraFlow shift.
No external ModelSamplingAuraFlow node required — shift is baked in.

Outputs:
  MODEL       — wire into TPG → NAG → Guider chain as normal
  sigma_plot  — σ(t) curve IMAGE, wire into Preview Image node
  analytics   — load report STRING, wire into text display node

nodes.title: MD: Look-Back Smoother 🌊
nodes.description:
MD: Look-Back Smoother 🌊

SNR-adaptive latent smoother. Suppresses harmonic hum from ODE manifold
shearing in ACE-Step XL Turbo early denoising steps.

Wire between sampler LATENT output and VAE Decode.
Works with any sampler (PingPong, Euler, DPM++, STORM, etc.)

Based on arXiv:2602.09449 Look-Ahead/Look-Back flows.
Validated: lambda_base=0.55, snr_power=1.3, ddim_uniform 25-step.

nodes.title: MD: STORM Hybrid Solver ⚡
nodes.description:
MD: STORM Hybrid Solver v2.0 ⚡

HPC-grade adaptive ODE sampler for flow-matching audio diffusion.

STORK (Stabilized Taylor RK) handles stiff early steps.
DPM++3M handles smooth late steps.
Auto-switches per step based on velocity field curvature.

Features:
• RK2/3/4/5 adaptive multi-order (single NFE, cached derivatives)
• Adaptive sub-stepping — splits step on U-turn detection
• Look-Back SNR smoother — suppresses harmonic hum
• SDE restarts — isotropic or velocity-aligned Langevin noise
• Full telemetry plot saved to ComfyUI output/ folder
• YAML input/template/params outputs

Validated configs:
    35-step simple:       look_back_lambda=0.35, snr_power=1.5
    25-step ddim_uniform: look_back_lambda=0.55, snr_power=1.3
